description_en: Attached villa in Farka for sale! In a modern and functional residence, with only 9 villas, designed for maximum comfort and quality living, with dedicated access for each, we offer attached villa for sale. Organized on 3 floors above ground, with an internal area of ​​255.44 m², the villa offers ample spaces, natural lighting and a layout thought out with details. Set on a plot of 292.59m² net, with landscaped outdoor areas and a dedicated parking space, this property is ideal for families looking for privacy, space and a high standard of living. Layout of the villa: Ground floor - 76.54 m² - Spacious living room with access to the veranda and courtyard - Separate or open kitchen - Daily toilets - Laundry First floor - 77.77 m² - 2 bedrooms - 1 bathroom - 1 storage room Second floor - 77.22 m² - 2 bedrooms - 2 bathrooms - stairs to the veranda Plot + Outdoor space net: 292.59 m² Landscaped yard, ideal for greenery, relaxation areas or children's playground Dedicated parking space Modern project with elegant volumes and contemporary facades Multi-storey structure suitable for large families Optimal lighting and favorable orientation Quietness, privacy and maximum comfort Regular infrastructure and systemized roads around the complex For more detailed information you can contact us!
